outcome: Incidence of congenital developmental dysplasia of the hip
cohort: Newborns from Yucatan, Mexico born between 2015 and 2019
finding: Maternal, neonatal, and perinatal factors are associated with developmental dysplasia of the hip in Yucatecan infants born during 2015-2019.
mod_finding: Neonates with hip dysplasia were heavier and more susceptible to be born by cesarean section.
